projects.name: Project: Art Boards
projects.purpose: Visualize resources and coordinate agent sessions with human-machine collaboration tools.
projects.description: Tools for coordinating agent sessions and discovering and visualizing resources and artefacts.

projects.name: Project: Art Domains
projects.purpose: Extends agentic working environments with structured instructions projected from stable sources of truth.
projects.description: Distributable artificial resources within knowledge and work domains: structures, templates, processes, agent instructions, modes, and skills.

projects.name: Project: Art JS
projects.purpose: Enable Art files to be authored as programs, with validation, language tooling, and automated projection to target formats.
projects.description: Libraries and tools for working with Art MD as a programming language, including records, resources, modules, programs, program builders, validators, projectors, language services, and related tooling.

projects.name: Project: Art Lib
projects.purpose: Build high quality, consistent, Cli and Tool experiences from composable units.
projects.description: Shared libraries and tools for building CLIs and Tools.

projects.name: Project: Art MD
projects.purpose: Express structured data in Markdown with an extensible language that enables human and machine authoring at scale and automated transformations.
projects.description: Language specification and JavaScript libraries for extracting structured data into a MDAST derived AST, with an open construct registry. Provides parsing, validation, transformation, and serialization of Art MD content.

projects.name: Project: Art Works
projects.purpose: Manage multi-repository development environments for parallel planning and execution.
projects.description: Tools for discovering projects, managing knowledge and context resources, and operating across multiple checkouts: cloning, visualizing, synchronizing, and executing commands.

projects.name: Project: Artificials
projects.purpose: Generate and manage (Art)ificial Driven Development environments.
projects.description: A collection of tools and resources to generate and manage knowledge artefacts and agent instructions.

projects.name: Project: Artisans
projects.purpose: Have fun with artificials.
projects.description: Creative and experimental micro projects developed entirely using Artificials.

projects.name: Project: No Comply
projects.purpose: Context-aware UI system built with SolidJS and modern CSS.
projects.description: SolidJS layered library ecosystem spanning foundational types, accessibility primitives, contexts and services, composable controllers, a themeable component library, and developer tooling.

projects.name: Project: Noodlestan Commons
projects.purpose: Keep Noodlestan repositories and Registry views consistent.
projects.description: A suite of tools for publishing, validating, and curating the Noodlestan monorepo manifests, records, dependencies, and Registry data.

projects.name: Project: Noodlestan Conventions
projects.purpose: Distributable Noodlestan conventions written in Art.
projects.description: Conventions packages for Noodlestan stack, including Typescript, JSX, Solid JS, and SCSS.

projects.name: Project: Noodlestan Management
projects.purpose: Coordinate Noodlestan projects and their roadmaps and orgnanize shared assets.
projects.description: Noodlestan's top-level roadmap, ideas, research notes, and incubation material.

projects.name: Project: Noodlestan Ops
projects.purpose: Infrastructure as code for Noodlestan projects.
projects.description: Terraform configurations for managing AWS resources: DNS zones, SSL certificates, S3 buckets, CloudFront distributions, and state backends. Organized into accounts, backend, domains, and modules.

projects.name: Project: Noodlestan Web
projects.purpose: Noodlestan says Hello World.
projects.description: Repository of Noodlestan websites — typically built with Astro.

projects.name: Project: Noodlestan Workspace Tooling
projects.purpose: Build tooling for Noodlestan workspaces.
projects.description: Esbuild CLI wrapper, ESLint config, and base TypeScript configs.

projects.name: Project: Purrception
projects.purpose: Extract and compose metadata from source code and artefacts.
projects.description: Collection of abstractions and tools for building metadata extraction pipelines from local and remote sources using heuristics, schemas, and factories.

projects.name: Project: Purrfect
projects.purpose: Extract, compose, and expose metadata to support the discovery, interpretation, and operation of artefacts.
projects.description: Collection of composable tools and abstractions for building metadata extraction pipelines, aggregations, indexes, visualizations, and metadata endpoints.

projects.name: Project: Purrfiles
projects.purpose: Define entity model and provide shared extraction tooling.
projects.description: Home of meta service, entity models, and the extraction tooling shared by Noodlestan docs sites.

projects.name: Project: Purrpose
projects.purpose: In browser source code and metadata transformations.
projects.description: Single-purpose utilities for in-browser transformations: JSX/TSX compilation, SolidJS JSX transform presets, and Shiki-based syntax highlighting.

projects.name: Project: Purrtrait
projects.purpose: Transform, render and visualize metadata about source code and artefacts.
projects.description: Collection of tools for rendering code, visualizing metadata, and creating representations for humans and tools.

projects.name: Project: Registry
projects.purpose: Publish machine-consumable Noodlestan registry views of namespaces, repositories, and projects.
projects.description: Data-only project hosting registry JSON views and their schemas, consumed by the Commons Registry Peer and other tooling through raw GitHub endpoints.
